title: robots.txt drops the non-standard Host line, and the database time zone is pinned to UTC

source.ref: ChatGPT outside audit, Nov 19 list (project thread: Close the ChatGPT audit leftovers), checked 2026-11-20

detail:
ChatGPT audit leftovers, checked 2026-11-20.

ROBOTS: production /robots.txt was read in full. Every Disallow mirrors PROTECTED_PATHS in proxy.ts or a token/funnel landing, and none of the 678 URLs in the live sitemap.xml matches a Disallow rule, so nothing advertised is blocked. One defect: app/robots.ts returned `host: SITE_URL`, which printed `Host: https://frequencylocal.com`. Host is not in the robots standard (RFC 9309); Google and Bing ignore it and Search Console lists it as an unknown directive, and Yandex wanted a bare host name. The field is removed; canonicals and the sitemap's absolute URLs already name the host.

TIME ZONE: production (Frequency Community) runs current_setting('TimeZone') = 'UTC', but pg_db_role_setting held no TimeZone for the database or any role, so UTC was only the server default. Migration 20270346240000_pin_database_time_zone_utc.sql runs `alter database <current_database()> set timezone to 'UTC'`. UTC, not Pacific, on purpose: local days are already computed from the person's or the Space's own zone, and the email gauge counts the UTC day; the pin changes no result today.

TERMS (same list, no change needed): app/terms/page.tsx already opens with "Draft pending legal review" (added 2026-11-19 in #5353) and production /terms renders it.

verify.note: Fails while robots.ts returns a host field or no migration pins the database time zone to UTC.
